title: WebKit cube faces collapse to zero-width after resize during motion
trigger: Five button cards,480×300px,effect:'cube',perPage:1,speed:1200,gap:0,cubeEffect:{slideShadows:true,perspective:900}; next(); observe actual intermediate transform/shadow phase; resize root/track to360×240,update(). Both horizontal and vertical configurations reproduce.
expected: At each enabled sampled frame, cube has a rendered and interactive face covering viewport center after resize/interruption.
actual: WebKit has positive360×240 viewport and activecard1, but all five physical slide DOMRects have width0 after update. All12postresize RAF observations hit track rather than a face or button; elementsFromPoint contains no slide. Captured screenshot is blank. Initial and pre-resize samples hit card0 correctly.
review: Confirmed DOM geometry and blank screenshot, not merely a restrictive hit-test expectation. Cube transforms/3D composition under WebKit after update require investigation; exact source cause is not established and no library fix was tried. C/F controls pass. Desktop and mobile are browser emulation of WebKit26.5 on Windows, not physical Safari/iPhone.
blockedTail: Fails after measured intermediate phase and twelve post-interruption RAF samples, before stable final-selection and subsequent navigation/cleanup assertions. This establishes a165–182ms observed blank span in focused reruns; no claim that it stays blank indefinitely.
observationScope: Each case repeated3/3 on WebKit desktop and WebKit mobile; each case passes3/3 in Chromium and Firefox. Original matrix singles retained. One screenshot inspected visually, all12WebKit trials corroborated by exact zero-width geometry and hit stack.
